question: A metallic wire carries a steady current. Explain the role of free electrons in producing this current and state the direction of conventional current.

options.A: The steady current is due to positive ions drifting in the wire, and conventional current is in the same direction as electron drift.
options.B: Free electrons remain stationary, while conventional current is in the direction of the electric field.
options.C: Free electrons acquire drift velocity opposite to the electric field and produce current; conventional current is taken opposite to the direction of electron drift.
options.D: Free electrons drift in the direction of the electric field, and conventional current is also in that direction.
